title: the MM2 letter D part 5 - the dracolisk, dragon and dustdigger turns
audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTER D PART 5 - the dracolisk, the DRAGON family of the Monster Manual II arc and the rest of the letter D close (the user Go call on the landed dinosaur walk). The pin-time walk from the print finds THIRTEEN entries on pp. 55-61: the dracolisk at the foot of p. 55, the DRAGON family head on pp. 55-56 (doctrine only, no stat block - the size roll, the 8 age stages, the infravision and detection, the fear aura, the saving-throw-by-hp/4 rule and the treasure-by-age ladder all pinned), and the 11 remaining stat blocks - the Cloud Dragon, the Faerie Dragon, the Mist Dragon, the Shadow Dragon, the Giant Dragonfly, the Dragon Horse, the Dragonnel, the Drelb, the Drider, the Duergar and the Dustdigger. TWELVE defs ride the R791 data_files extension in the MM1 registry schema, registry 603 -> 615. THE GRIDS: the 12-row DgStats stat grid (armor class, hit dice, bonus, avgHp, attacks, xp, xp/hp, lair, move, magic resistance) plus the 8-row faerie color grid (magic resistance, magic-user level, druid level by color) and the 8-row faerie age grid (level, hit point floor, hit point ceiling). THE D-FLIP: the Letter D gap box flips to closed - the letter D walk is complete, 9 closed 28 open. THE SETTLED READS (capture primary, the 1eonline transcription and the archive.org djvu the cross-check voices): the giant dragonfly hit dice "7 (8+1-8)" is the print line pinned verbatim (the capture and djvu agree; the grid reads the 7); the cloud xp rider "6100 + 10/hp + 100/hp over 48" and the mist rider "3450 + 5/hp + 50/hp over 36" stay pinned as riders (the defs carry the base and per-hp cells); the faerie "See below" hit dice read as the 4 hit dice the prose prints (the faerie attacks as 4 hit dice monsters); the faerie "See below" magic resistance reads 0 in the grid (the color grid carries the per-color percents); the dragonfly "Save as 16th-level magic-user" reads 0 (the R155 save-as read); the cloud and mist or-form armor classes and magic resistances read the gaseous best (AC -3 and -2, MR 50 and 30); the cloud, mist and shadow ranged hit dice read the low end (the kuei precedent); the duergar "Variable/variable" xp rides the by_level carry (the dervish and dwarf precedent, no fixed xp fields); the duergar treasure "Individuals M, Q; Lair B (magic only), F" (the capture "M.O" the OCR misread); the dragonnel size L (24'+ long) (the capture inches the misread); the duergar "have been know to dwell" and the dragon ancient "(40+ years)" print typos pinned verbatim; the duergar armor-list leading "+" marks are the capture column artifact. LOADER SEMANTICS: the duergar "1 (or more)" attacks read the max 1; every Nil lair reads 0. ONE REGTEST PATCH: the R803 live def walk at the R227 anchor (the R782 site-block pattern, no census marker), its registry census a FLOOR 603 -> at least 615.
